swap_submitted_without_deadline.meaning: user submits a swap transaction to the Router without any deadline parameter

tx_delayed_in_mempool.meaning: the submitted transaction is held by a validator or remains in the mempool for an extended period

market_conditions_changed.meaning: market conditions have changed unfavorably for the user by the time the delayed transaction would execute

executed_after_significant_delay.meaning: the swap transaction is executed after a significant delay relative to when the user intended it to execute

assumptions: The Router/Core lack of a deadline parameter is treated as the reason no deadline bound exists; it is not encoded as a precondition fact.
'Significant delay' is a qualitative condition; no numeric time bound is given in the report.

unresolved.description: The report does not define a numeric threshold for 'significant delay' or 'extended period', so the delay bound is represented only by the qualitative executed_after_significant_delay observable.

limitations: The impact is formalized as the qualitative execution-after-significant-delay observable; no concrete time value is available.
Other impacts (unwanted_trades, loss_of_opportunity) are not covered by this plan.
